compactRecord.rs: A low-elevation (602m), gentle secondary Vosges pass with pleasant forested scenery but no dramatic views; a small shelter and historic border post at the summit add mild interest; a cat. 4 appearance in Tour de France Femmes 2022 gives it minor cycling notoriety.
compactRecord.td: Col d'Urbeis is a quiet, low-gradient secondary pass through the forested Vosges, once a Franco-German border crossing. A modest shelter marks the summit; it was a cat. 4 climb in the 2022 Tour de France Femmes but holds little wider appeal.
